implementationWarning: Applies ONLY to structures that already exist in the mod. Verify the structure's real registry name/bounding box. No new structures are created by this pack.
structureRegistryNameNote: Fill in after verifying existing structures in worldgen data.
triggerVolume: structure bounding box + 8 block margin; use StructureManager / StructureStart bounding boxes on client via chunk structure references or block-entity markers

effectsUsed.anchor: altars, pillars, glass/crystal decoration blocks (use blocks present; do not add new ones)
around entrances and pillars, 0.5-3 b above floor

blendWithBiome.note: Structure effects add to, never replace, biome effects. Total still obeys the biome preset's maxParticlesAlive.

softFog.implementation: Optional; needs fog event hook; omit if not wanted.

designNotes: Slow, sacred, golden pulses. Resonance rings are rare, like a ritual heartbeat.
